key_insight: MatHarness supports open-ended computational materials research from ideation to manuscript by combining robust execution, evolving scientific reasoning, and multi-agent review.
engineering_relevance: The harness offers a framework for coordinating long-running simulation campaigns while retaining human approval and strategic oversight.
method: Pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing improve execution robustness.
Persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model support plan revision.
A heterogeneous multi-agent round table operates under targeted human oversight.
evidence_signal: In a multi-week Cu–Zn surface-segregation study using roughly 1,000 GPU-hours, 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations prescreened 50 production DFT relaxations; the system revised its plan six times, recovered from failed calculations, and an independent auditor overturned one over-attributed claim.
watch_item: Evidence comes from one research campaign, and its materials conclusions are limited to sampled metallic dilute-limit models with facet- and coverage-dependent exceptions.
paper_title: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
